shortDescription: Electricity market reforms in Guangdong, one of China’s economic powerhouses, could signal a broader slowdown in the country’s natural gas demand, according to Bloomberg.The reforms are reshaping power use in the province and clouding the outlook for gas consumption.

title: China Gas Demand Outlook Darkens as Guangdong Reforms Shift Power Use
